title: Terms of Use for Frog's Dream Free Printables and Mega Pack
metaDescription: How you may use Frog's Dream. A free license for home, classroom and event printables, embedding rules, the Mega Pack license, and Polish governing law.
intro: These terms apply to frogsdream.com, its free tools and printables, the embeddable tools and the paid Mega Pack. They are written to be read, not to trip anyone up. By using the site you agree to them.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Frog's Dream is a small independent website run by a private individual in Poland. The person responsible is named in our [privacy policy](/privacy/), and you can reach us through the [contact page](/contact/).

sections.heading: Free license for the tools and printables
body: The tools are free to use, with no account. You may print, copy and use the sheets you make on this site, as many times as you like:

* at home and with your family
* in your classroom, school, homeschool group, library, club or care home
* at parties, showers, weddings, reunions and other events, including community and charity events
* in online lessons, for example by sharing a PDF with your own students

You may not sell the generated files or printouts as a product, or offer them for sale as part of a bundle, on marketplaces such as teacher resource stores, print-on-demand shops or online craft stores. Using our cards at a school or charity fundraiser is fine (check your local rules on prize games); selling the cards themselves as printables is not.
Please leave the small credit line at the bottom of each sheet in place when you share files with others.

sections.heading: Your content
body: The words and titles you type into a tool are yours. They are processed in your browser and are not sent to us. You are responsible for what you put on your sheets and for making sure it suits the people who will play.
If you create a share link, the list travels inside the link itself. Anyone with the link can see the list, so don't include private information.

sections.heading: Embedding our tools
sections.body: You may embed the bingo card generator, word search maker and word scramble maker on your own website using the codes on our [embed page](/embed/). Please keep the credit link visible, don't present the tool as your own product, and don't charge people to use it. We may change or remove the embedded tools, and we may ask you to remove an embed from a site that is unlawful or harmful.

sections.heading: What belongs to us
sections.body: The site design, the frog mascot and illustrations, the code, the written guides and the curated theme lists belong to Frog's Dream. You may quote short parts of a guide with a link back. Please don't copy whole pages, the mascot artwork or the tools to another website, and don't use automated scraping that puts heavy load on the server.

sections.heading: The Mega Pack
body: The Mega Pack is a paid download of ready-made PDFs. It is sold by **Lemon Squeezy** as merchant of record, which means your purchase contract and payment are handled by Lemon Squeezy under its own terms, and Lemon Squeezy charges any sales tax or VAT that applies. We provide the files and support.
**Mega Pack license.** When you buy the pack, you get a personal, non-transferable license to:

* print the files as often as you like for your own home, your own parties and events, and **one classroom**, meaning the classes you teach yourself
* hand printed copies to your students, guests and players
* keep copies of the files on your own devices

You may not resell, share, sublicense or give away the files or the ZIP, upload them to a public or shared website or drive where others can download them, or use them to make products for sale. Each teacher who wants to use the pack needs their own copy.
**Refunds.** Lemon Squeezy handles payment and VAT; if a file doesn't work for you, email us for a refund within 14 days.

**Your statutory rights.** If you are a consumer in the EU, you normally have 14 days to withdraw from an online purchase. For digital downloads, that right ends once the download starts, if you agreed at checkout to receive the files straight away and acknowledged that you lose the right of withdrawal. Our refund promise above applies in addition to that, and nothing in these terms limits the rights you have by law if the files are faulty or not as described.

body: We work hard to keep the tools working and the word lists accurate and suitable, but the site and its printables are provided **as is**, without any promise that they will be error-free, always available or right for your particular purpose. Please check a sheet before printing a whole class set.

Games and charts are for fun and learning. The bedtime and reward charts, and any guide that mentions children's sleep or behavior, are general ideas, not medical, psychological or professional advice. For scavenger hunts and outdoor games, the adults running them are responsible for supervision and safety.

sections.body: We may add, change or remove tools, themes and pages, and we may update these terms. When we do, the date at the top of this page changes. A change does not take away a license you already have for a Mega Pack you bought.

sections.body: These terms are governed by the law of Poland. If you are a consumer living in another country, you keep the protection of the mandatory consumer laws of your own country, and you may bring a claim in the courts where you live. Otherwise, the courts of Poland have jurisdiction. If any part of these terms is found invalid, the rest still applies.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: If something here is unclear, or you'd like to ask about a use not covered above, please [get in touch](/contact/). We are happy to say yes to most reasonable requests.
